item.title: a small guide to writing for skimmers
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months writing for skimmers bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Writing for skimmers shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: a small guide to writing for skimmers
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: writing for skimmers is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Writing for skimmers shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: rethinking writing for skimmers
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months writing for skimmers bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Writing for skimmers shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
